narrative.overview: Askme operates like a precision tool on a cool neutral desk: icon rail navigation, indigo accent for primary actions and active wayfinding, and reading columns tuned for digest scanning plus RAG chat. Expression stays Operate-mode familiar—Linear density in chrome, Notion comfort in prose blocks.
keyCharacteristics: Cool `#FAFAFA` stage with white raised panels and `#E4E4E7` hairline borders
Indigo accent `#5E6AD2` for primary buttons, active nav, progress fills
64px icon sidebar with micro labels (Comp A), top job status strip, brief + ask split workspace
Inter UI type at fixed rem steps; 65ch reading measure in digest/article
English default UI with persistent EN/ZH toggle in sidebar rail
SVG logo mark in rail brand slot
Accessibility: skip link, landmarks, live regions, modal focus trap, keyboard-reachable hover actions

rules.name: The Indigo Sparingly Rule
rules.body: Accent marks actions, selection, and progress—not large background fields.

dos: Do keep EN default with one-click ZH toggle in the sidebar.
Do use the logo SVG in the rail brand slot.
Do preserve focus-visible outlines on all interactive elements.
Do use `.ui-icon-btn` (36×36px min) for compact icon-only controls (⋯, ↻, drag handles).
Do use `.ui-chip-btn` for inline citation/index chips (24px min touch floor).
Do use documented type steps (micro = 0.6875rem) for dense inline actions.
donts: Don't reintroduce warm parchment palette from the previous world.
Don't use colored side-tab borders on cards or nav items.
